Nova Pharmacy: 9.68x ROAS with CRO, GA4 Clarity & UI/UX Optimization

9.68x

Challenge
Nova Pharmacy needed clearer visibility across Meta ROI, CMS revenue, and GA4 funnel behavior so performance decisions were tied to both traffic quality and on-site conversion.
My role
Paid ads performance analysis, GA4 funnel diagnostics, CRO opportunity mapping, UI/UX optimization direction, and reporting clarity across Meta and CMS revenue data.
Platforms
Meta Ads, GA4 funnel exploration, CMS revenue dashboard, UI/UX review
Approach
Reviewed campaign-level Meta performance to identify ROI drivers, then connected the result back to CMS revenue and GA4 funnel movement. The CRO work focused on diagnosing product-view, add-to-cart, checkout, and purchase friction, then translating the data into UI/UX enhancement priorities.

Hive Analytics - B2B Agency Lead Generation - Meta Ads

768 B2B Leads for an Analytics Agency at 156.70 EGP Cost per Lead

768
Total B2B leads

Challenge
Generate qualified B2B leads for Hive Analytics while keeping campaign-level CPL, spend, and outbound click quality visible across multiple markets.
My role
Meta lead-generation campaign setup, market-level performance tracking, budget efficiency review, and campaign reporting for an agency lead funnel.

Meta Ads - Lead Generation
Outcome
The lead-generation account produced 768 total leads from 120,344.13 EGP in spend, with an average cost per lead of 156.70 EGP and 2.79% outbound CTR. Egypt was the main volume driver with 581 leads, while the Hive Analytics campaign delivered 77 leads at a lower 130.22 EGP CPL.

How I Work

How I analyze, execute,
and improve performance

A practical workflow for campaign management, funnel analysis, reporting, and optimization.

01
Audit & Diagnose
Review paid ads, Shopify, GA4, campaign structure, tracking setup, creative performance, funnel behavior, and revenue attribution gaps.
02
Structure Campaigns
Clarify campaign objectives, funnel stages, audience groups, budget allocation, creative testing paths, and performance benchmarks.
03
Build Reporting
Create dashboards, reporting sheets, GA4 views, and platform-level tracking systems needed to manage paid growth.
04
Execute Tests
Launch campaign tests, retargeting improvements, creative experiments, funnel fixes, and budget moves tied to specific revenue goals.
05
Report, Test & Optimize
Track the right metrics, identify what is working, diagnose what is leaking, and improve performance through continuous testing.
